item.description: GUWAHATI: Kheroni in Assam’s West Karbi Anglong district remained on the boil on Tuesday, December 23, as large groups of Karbis and non-Karbis—many armed with sticks and including women—gathered on the streets, pushing the situation to the brink even as police exercised restraint to prevent escalation. item.title: Assam Book Fair's Last Leg Begins in Guwahati from December 24, to End on January 6
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam Book Fair, which has been underway across several towns in the state since October, is set to begin its Guwahati edition from Wednesday, December 24. The Guwahati fair will run until January 6, marking the final leg of the multi-city literary event. item.title: Protests Rock Bangladesh High Commission in New Delhi Following Lynching of Hindu Man
item.description: GUWAHATI: Violent protests erupted outside the Bangladesh High Commission in New Delhi on Tuesday, December 23, following the killing of a Hindu man in Bangladesh’s Mymensingh district last week. The demonstrations were organised by the Vishwa Hindu Parishad and Bajrang Dal, with protestors demanding accountability from Bangladeshi authorities over incidents involving minorities. item.title: 50,000 YABA Tablets Worth ₹2 Crore Seized in Assam's Sribhumi; One Arrested
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam police have seized fifty thousand YABA tablets valued at ₹2 crore in Sribhumi district, in a joint operation carried out by Sribhumi Police and the Border Security Force. One person was arrested in connection with the seizure following an operation based on specific intelligence inputs. item.description: GUWAHATI: Veteran Assamese actress and classical dancer Ranjana Sharma Bordoloi has passed away at the age of 80.
